notes: Sequential fresh four-worker processes; relay on CPUs 0-3 and fixed client on 4-7. Same exact Origin header sent in every arm. 64 churn workers verify assigned ID, monotonic self-delivery and Close acknowledgement; traffic uses 32 pairs, 1 KiB values, 16 message windows and intentional TCP departure. Four repetitions alternate arm order; only control and unrestricted new build are compared here; finite loopback checks, no TLS or production capacity claim. Policy list64 has matching origin last. Server-only CPU includes setup/teardown at 10 ms tick resolution; p99 values are fixed histogram upper bounds.
